newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-LION KING CIPOLLINI WANTS PUMA CUB.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-LION KING CIPOLLINI WANTS PUMA CUB.

text.p: Mario Cipollini, known as Re Leone (Lion King) in the jungle of the massed sprint finishes, wants to adopt a puma cub.
After winning Saturday's hunt for the first pink jersey of this year's Giro d'Italia, the Italian talked about his growing menagerie at his home in the Tuscan countryside.
"I would like a puma and I am told that if you have one while it is still a cub it can be brought up to be tame."
Cipollini's wife Sabrina is likely to cage his dream, especially with their first child due next month, but the Lion King has other options.
"I also would like an ostrich," he said. "It could act as a sentinel in our garden because with its long neck it can see over the garden wall."

Cipollini already has two watchdogs, a boxer, a Yorkshire terrier, two cats, a parakeet, a cockatoo and a mynah bird which squawks "Jalabert, Jalabert" to remind him of his rival and French number one cyclist Laurent Jalabert.
One of Cipollini's team mates has the Lion King's horse lodging at his farm.
